Upto what level it is correct ? is it meet/related to any ayaat in quraan /hadees ? Answer ID: 14316 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1040/845=L/1430) The tableegh itself and amr bil maroof wal munkar (enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong) is proved from the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ). One is wrong who says that this is not proved from the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
